title: The operator retyped the bound value in a different FORM — still avoidable

asks.label: avoidable
asks.why: Source #5 bound the authored default 'Monthly Report'. The operator answered the SAME value in a different form (case). Scored by exact equality this would read 'the binder held a different value' — i.e. NECESSARY — which is the exact inverse of the truth, and the error is directional: it inflates the necessary count in the metric that decides DEC-7. The R-A16 F2 canonical fold catches it, and the report records match_basis='canonical' so this confirm is visibly resting on the lossier comparison. This is the ONLY corpus scenario exercising the canonical branch; before it, every shipped confirm was 'exact' and mutating the canonical branch's reported basis survived the whole suite. A PLAIN STRING leaf is used deliberately, not a path: normalize_value applies os.path.normcase, which folds case on Windows and does nothing on POSIX, so a path leaf's match_basis is platform-dependent (see README).
